synopsis.text:
It's the year 2777. Due to nuclear wars and natural disasters, Earth's population has decreased dramatically and only five island are left, forming the nation of Xexyz. In Xexyz, humans, spirits and faeries have lived peacefully for centuries under the reign of King Xeu Star. One day, Xexyz is attacked by Goruza who murders the king, builds mechanical castles on each island and captures the queen of each island. You take on the role of a soldier named Apollo who wants to put an end to Goruza's reign.

Controlling Apollo, it is your task to free all five islands. Freeing an island is done in several different phases that feature 'Jump'n Shoot' as well as 'Shooter' levels (called "Action Mode" and "Shooting Mode"). The first level of each island is a Jump'n Shoot level that contains many doors to shops, bonus games, friendly NPCs or mid-bosses. NPCs will sometimes give you important hints, items or weapons; bonus games can be played to win some money ("Balls"); defeating mid-bosses (and thereby freeing a Fairy) will get you a cash reward and shops also offer weapons and items. Weapons differ largely in attack power and range. Items have temporary effects such as invincibility or improved jumping abilities. In an island's first level, you will have to find a secret room and defeat a boss, for which you will receive a Force Star that is needed to gain access to a mechanical castle. Mechanical castles look similar to other Jump'n Shoot levels but are more complex.

Once you have made your way to a "Cyborg Rider", a self-scrolling Shooter sequence starts in which you have to shoot your way through lots of enemies while picking up speed and weapon power-ups.
At the end of this sequence you will leave the Cyborg Rider, and step onto a floating platform for a boss fight. After the boss is defeated, another Shooter sequence with another boss at the end awaits, but this time, the boss if fought from the Cyborg Rider. After defeating this boss, you start the process over with a Jump'n Shoot level.

Dans Xexyz sur Nes, des extraterrestres ont attaqué la Terre, déjà en sale état après une guerre nucléaire. Incarnez le sauveur de l'humanité en éliminant toute la vermine galactique à l'aide de power-up surpuissants dans ce jeu de tir/plates-formes à défilement horizontal.

Xexyz spielt im postapokalyptischen Jahr 2777, nachdem die Erde durch einen Atomkrieg und Naturkatastrophen verwüstet wurde und die Inselnation Xexyz nun von außerirdischen Robotern bedroht wird.
nnDas Spiel dreht sich um die Hauptfigur Apollo, der das Spiel zwischen Plattform-Side-Scrolling-Action (ähnlich der Super Mario Bros. Serie) und Side-Scrolling-Shooter-Action (ähnlich der Gradius-Serie von Konami) durchläuft. Ziel des Spiels ist es, den bösen Goruza zu vernichten, Prinzessin Maria und den Planeten zu retten.
nnIn den Jump'n'Run-Levels lassen besiegte Gegner Lebens- oder Geld-Power-Ups fallen. Apollo kann die Währung sammeln, um sie gegen Power-Ups und Informationen einzutauschen, sowie Zugang zu Minispielen erhalten. Händler sind in den Jump'n'Run-Levels durch Türen oder versteckte Tore verteilt. In den Shooter-Levels kann der Spieler "S"- und "P"-Gegenstände erwerben, die die Geschwindigkeit bzw. die Waffen verbessern.

Es el año 2777. Debido a las guerras nucleares y los desastres naturales, la población de la Tierra ha disminuido dramáticamente y solo quedan cinco islas, formando la nación de Xexyz. En Xexyz, los humanos, los espíritus y las hadas han vivido pacíficamente durante siglos bajo el reinado del Rey Xeu Star. Un día, Xexyz es atacado por Goruza, quien asesina al rey, construye castillos mecánicos en cada isla y captura a la reina de cada isla. Asumes el papel de un soldado llamado Apolo que quiere poner fin al reinado de Goruza.

L'anno è il 2777. A causa di guerre nucleari e disastri naturali, la popolazione terrestre è diminuita drasticamente e rimangono solo cinque isole, formando la nazione di Xexyz. A Xexyz, umani, spiriti e fate hanno vissuto pacificamente per secoli sotto il regno di Re Xeu Star. Un giorno, Xexyz viene attaccato da Goruza, che assassina il re, costruisce castelli a molla su ogni isola e cattura la regina di Xexyz. ogni isola. Assumi il ruolo di un soldato di nome Apollo che vuole porre fine al regno di Goruza.

É o ano de 2777. Devido a guerras nucleares e desastres naturais, a população da Terra diminuiu drasticamente e restam apenas cinco ilhas, formando a nação de Xexyz. Em Xexyz, humanos, espíritos e fadas vivem pacificamente há séculos sob o reinado do rei Xeu Star. Um dia, Xexyz é atacado por Goruza, que mata o rei, constrói castelos mecânicos em cada ilha e captura a rainha de cada ilha. Você assume o papel de um soldado chamado Apolo que quer pôr um fim ao reinado de Goruza.

tips.description: Commencez à jouer et atteignez le premier mur. Maintenez enfonçé le bouton Bas pendant à peu prés deux secondes et sautez pour atteindre le niveau suivant.
Commencez une nouvelle partie et faites B, A, B, Start, Haut et Bas.
